metadata.name: SearchAccountByCustomer
metadata.description: The purpose of this is API to search the Accounts by Customer.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: CustomerID
request_fields.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abc2123 Condition: Mandatory if no other parameter inputted

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Card holder's First name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Condition: Mandatory if no other parameter inputted Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Card holder's last name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:Smith Condition: Mandatory if no other parameter inputted Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SSNLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Card holder's last four digit of SSN Valid Values:1120 Format:XXXX Example:1120 Condition: Mandatory if no other parameter inputted Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: EmailID
request_fields.description: Card holder  Email ID Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Condition: Mandatory if no other parameter inputted Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 256

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Mobile Phone Number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:987567757 Condition: Mandatory if no other parameter inputted Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: SSUserID
request_fields.description: Self Service User ID of the Account Holder Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:abc123 Condition: Mandatory if no other parameter inputted Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of Transaction which can be view in one Batch Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:20

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:12

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: SearchResult
children.description: This tag refer to the any search list .

children.name: MerchantName
children.description: Name of the Merchant Allowable Values: 100

children.name: ProductName
children.description: The tag reflects the product name Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CustomerID
children.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abc2123 Allowable Values: 25

children.name: AccountID
children.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder/AccountHolder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

children.name: ApplicationNumber
children.description: Unique Number generated for the Account creation Application . Valid Values:0-9 Example:8002201421

children.name: FirstName
children.description: Card holder's First name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: LastName
children.description: Card holder's last name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:Smith Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CosignerFirstName
children.description: Indicates the cosigner first name. Example:John Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CosignerLastName
children.description: Indicates the cosigner last name. Example:Smith Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CosignerSNSuffix
children.description: Manually assigned status on account Valid Values:  Closed, Active Format: XXXXX Example: Active Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountManualStatus
children.description: Manually assigned status on account Valid Values:  Closed, Active Format: XXXXX Example: Active Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountGeneratedStatus
children.description: Gets or sets the generated status.

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: Current balance of account/Debtor Owing Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:200.00

children.name: IsCoApplicant
children.description: Flag to decide if a Account is having Co-Applicant or not. Valid Values:0, 1 Example:0

children.name: OpenToBuy
children.description: Remaining Credit Limit which can be used for further posting. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXX.XX Example:200.00

children.name: CompanyName
children.description: Company Name Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 26

children.name: CompanyNumber
children.description: Company Number Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXX Example:1234

children.name: CorporateAccountNumber
children.description: Corporate Account Number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: IsApplicationPending
children.description: Indicates whether application is pending or not

children.name: SysOrgId
children.description: Used for authentication and issued by Core Card. This is a static value to represent institution. Valid Values:0-9 Example:5

children.name: PrimaryCurrencyCode
children.description: 3 digit Code assiciated with the Currency Valid Values: Refer' Primary Currency Code' section of Appendix Format: XXX Example: 840 Allowable Values: 3
